from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, py_compile, tempfile
ROOT=Path.cwd()
P=ROOT/'control/bridge_commands/command_bus_poller.py'
py_compile.compile(str(P), doraise=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bus_e005',P)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
base={'schema':'PREDICTION_BRIDGE_COMMAND_V1','task_id':'HEADLESS-E005-TEST','action':'BRIDGE_PING','created_at_utc':'2026-10-01T06:30:00Z','live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False,'intelligence_tier':'C','issuer':{'model':'GPT-5.6 Sol','reasoning_level':'UNAVAILABLE_TO_RUNTIME'}}
cmd=dict(base,delivery_mode='headless')
ok,reason=mod.validate_command(cmd)
assert ok and reason=='OK', (ok,reason)
route,source=mod.resolve_route(cmd)
assert source=='headless' and route=={'chat_id':'HEADLESS_CONTROL','consumer_id':None}
bad=dict(cmd,route_task_id='SOME-ROUTE')
ok,reason=mod.validate_command(bad)
assert not ok and reason=='HEADLESS_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN'
unknown=dict(base,delivery_mode='magic')
ok,reason=mod.validate_command(unknown)
assert not ok and reason=='BAD_DELIVERY_MODE'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    t=Path(td)
    mod.ROUTES=t/'routes'
    mod.ROUTE_FILE=t/'route.json'
    chat=dict(base)
    route,source=mod.resolve_route(chat)
    assert route is None and source=='pinned'
print('HEADLESS_SOURCE_CANARY_E005=PASS')
